notes: Pure functions of (params, tile, tMs). Tile fields come from out/layout.json: x, y in 0..1, ring, angle (deg from master, 0 = +x (right), increasing clockwise on screen since y points down), index, q, r. hsv(h,1,1) is standard HSV->RGB with h in degrees. Output per tile is [r,g,b] 0..255. Reference implementation: tools/effects.js.

effects.name: ripple
effects.label: Ripple
effects.formula: d = hexDistance(tile, origin); P = maxD + 2; ph = (t/1000*speed) mod P; k = max(0, 1 - |ph - d|); rgb = round(color*k)

effects.name: spiral
effects.label: Spiral
effects.formula: h = (tile.angle + tile.ring*30 + t/1000*speed*360) mod 360; rgb = hsv(h,1,1)

effects.name: sparkle
effects.label: Sparkle
effects.formula: frameN = floor(t/100); u = hash01(tile.index, frameN) with hash01(a,b) = (((a*73856093) xor (b*19349663)) mod 1000003)/1000003 using 32-bit unsigned ints; rgb = u < density ? color : [0,0,0]
